title: Splat Lab
summary: Drop fruit from different heights and see what splats. Press Drop as fast as you like — up to 5 fruit at once.
description: Pick a fruit and a height on a continuous slider, then press Drop, again and again if you like: up to 5 fruit fall into the same drop zone at once, each holding, cracking, splitting, or smashing on its own.

safety.privacy: Local-only play with no accounts, chat, sharing, or saved data.
safety.notes: No gore: broken fruit shows cartoon skin pieces, irregular flesh chunks, and seeds only. There is no toughness control — every fruit breaks at its own fixed real-world-inspired speed. Splat sound effects are generated in the browser with Web Audio (no audio files, no network request); a visible on/off sound toggle is provided, defaults to on, and is not persisted between visits.

externalDependencies.name: three.js core
externalDependencies.reason: three.js core module, imported by three.module.js.

externalDependencies.name: cannon-es
externalDependencies.reason: Physics simulation for the falling fruit and their pieces.
